name: GeoStock
summary: Shows per-location stock on the product page plus a store-locator map, so shoppers can see which branch has the item. It displays inventory rather than managing it.
best_for: retailers with physical locations who want shoppers to see per-store stock and find the nearest branch on the product page itself
skip_if: you are online-only, there are no locations to show, or you need actual inventory management, which this is not
honest_knock: Know what this is before you buy it: despite the name it is a storefront widget, not an inventory system. It displays the stock you already track in Shopify per location, and adds a store-locator map: it does not manage, forecast or reconcile anything. If you came looking for multi-location inventory management, that is a different category and a different budget. What it does do well is close a specific gap: a shopper who can see that a nearby store has the item is a shopper who does not abandon.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Base Plan · per month after a 14 day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/product-inventory-information, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026; first read 2026-08-18) Three plans: Free, Base Plan at $9.99 a month and Plus Plan at $29.99 a month, the paid two with a 14 day free trial, billed in USD every 30 days. Free costs $0 and shows stock for up to 2 locations, availability by location, an interactive store locator with search, directions and contact details, and business hours for each location; inside the app it reads “Free · 2 locations · Standard design”. It was not on the listing when we read it on 20 September 2026. Base Plan adds unlimited locations and variants, stock thresholds with custom colours, nearest store detection by IP, country filters, bin location and pickup, and the widget on product, cart and collection pages. Plus Plan adds no features, only onboarding, priority support with video calls, custom theme integration help, same day fixes and direct access to the dev team, and it is aimed at Shopify Plus merchants. The paid amounts are unchanged since 18 August 2026. Inside the app only Free and Base Plan were on offer; Plus appeared on the listing alone, and Shopify's approval screen for Base asked for a payment method, $9.99 every 30 days after the 14 day trial. On 17 November 2026 the listing showed 4.8 from 80 ratings, against 4.9 from 99 on 20 September. Developer sohkal llc, 6381 Almaden Rd, San Jose, CA, US; on the App Store since 28 March 2019.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested GeoStock on a Shopify development store: the install, a three step onboarding on the Free plan, two of three locations chosen, the app embed and the block Product inventory added in the theme editor, and the stock per location on a product page. The first result came after about 5 minutes and about 30 steps and showed My Custom Location 50, but the app said that 1 of the 2 selected locations was no longer valid and not published, so the second location never showed, and a product stocked only there showed Not Available. The Basic approval screen asked for a payment method and was cancelled. The theme was put back and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form of the App Store listing (English) was submitted in our own tab at about 19:20; the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and Install was clicked. The app is called GeoStock Inventory By Location in the admin and GeoStock: Multi Location Stock in the App Store. We went straight into the app, with no payment step. No card was asked. The admin was in English. Onboarding in 3 steps: Which stores should shoppers see (3 Shopify locations offered, with the line 0 selected, Free publishes up to 2), Add GeoStock to your store (the app embed and an inventory block), and Setup complete. Core action, show stock per location on a product page: 2 of the 3 locations were chosen, the app embed was switched on and the block Product inventory was added to Product information in the theme editor (in our own tab) and saved, which is needed to see the result. The first result in the preview came at about 19:25, about 5 minutes after the install and about 30 steps, many of them navigation in the theme editor. At first the block showed only Not Available on the products tried (Appointment, 3p Fulfilled Snowboard, Hydrogen). On The Collection Snowboard: Hydrogen, which has 50 available at the Shop location in Shopify, the block kept showing Not Available. In the app, the page Store locator showed 1 selected location(s) are no longer valid and are not published. Choose replacements. next to 2 of 2 locations selected (the location names were not visible in the list). Save locations gave Locations saved., but the warning stayed. On The Multi-location Snowboard the preview then showed My Custom Location 50; the Shop location did not appear. So stock per location works for one of the two chosen locations, and the other was not published; a product stocked only there showed Not Available. Why the second location counted as no longer valid was not found. Plans: the app screen Plan & billing showed Current plan Free, 2 locations, Standard design, 14 trial day(s) remaining, and a button Start a trial with Shopify Basic Plan $9.99/month; Free includes a store locator with up to 2 locations, search, directions, e-mail and business hours, and the standard design. Only Basic could be chosen in the app; a Plus Plan at $29.99 was not offered in the app. The App Store listing of 17 November says Free plan available and Free trial available, with a rating of 4.8 (80). Checkout: Start a trial opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: Base Plan, $9,99 USD every 30 days, a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec, Subtotal $9,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $9,99 due 1 Dec, and Add payment method, with Approve greyed out. The sentence that you will not be billed for this test charge was not there and a payment method was asked, so nothing was approved; Cancel was clicked, no card was entered and nothing was paid. Difference with the dossier: the dossier says there is no free plan, but the app and the listing have a Free plan with a store locator for up to 2 locations; the rating on the listing is 4.8 from 80 reviews while the dossier says 4.9 from 99. The price fields are not changed here; this is for the price bundle. Cancelling: no subscription was started; the uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, GeoStock, Uninstall) says that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and requires a reason (Testing multiple apps was chosen). Not tested: the Plus Plan (not offered in the app), a custom theme integration, batch loading with many locations, back-in-stock alerts (Notify me), the store locator map, detecting the nearest store from the visitor's location, and the paid Basic features. Clean up: in the theme the block Product inventory was removed and the app embed was switched off and saved, so the theme is as before the test; GeoStock was uninstalled with the reason Testing multiple apps and no longer appeared in the list of installed apps; our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: About 30 steps and about 5 minutes were needed to see the first result, mostly in the theme editor; one of the two chosen locations was not published and the warning stayed after Locations saved; a product stocked only at that location showed Not Available; the Plus plan was not offered in the app; the approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested GeoStock on a Shopify development store: the install, a three step onboarding on the Free plan, two of three locations chosen, the app embed and the block Product inventory added in the theme editor, and the stock per location on a product page. The first result came after about 5 minutes and about 30 steps and showed My Custom Location 50, but the app said that 1 of the 2 selected locations was no longer valid and not published, so the second location never showed, and a product stocked only there showed Not Available. The Basic approval screen asked for a payment method and was cancelled. The theme was put back and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form of the App Store listing (English) was submitted in our own tab at about 19:20; the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and Install was clicked. The app is called GeoStock Inventory By Location in the admin and GeoStock: Multi Location Stock in the App Store. We went straight into the app, with no payment step. No card was asked. The admin was in English. Onboarding in 3 steps: Which stores should shoppers see (3 Shopify locations offered, with the line 0 selected, Free publishes up to 2), Add GeoStock to your store (the app embed and an inventory block), and Setup complete. Core action, show stock per location on a product page: 2 of the 3 locations were chosen, the app embed was switched on and the block Product inventory was added to Product information in the theme editor (in our own tab) and saved, which is needed to see the result. The first result in the preview came at about 19:25, about 5 minutes after the install and about 30 steps, many of them navigation in the theme editor. At first the block showed only Not Available on the products tried (Appointment, 3p Fulfilled Snowboard, Hydrogen). On The Collection Snowboard: Hydrogen, which has 50 available at the Shop location in Shopify, the block kept showing Not Available. In the app, the page Store locator showed 1 selected location(s) are no longer valid and are not published. Choose replacements. next to 2 of 2 locations selected (the location names were not visible in the list). Save locations gave Locations saved., but the warning stayed. On The Multi-location Snowboard the preview then showed My Custom Location 50; the Shop location did not appear. So stock per location works for one of the two chosen locations, and the other was not published; a product stocked only there showed Not Available. Why the second location counted as no longer valid was not found. Plans: the app screen Plan & billing showed Current plan Free, 2 locations, Standard design, 14 trial day(s) remaining, and a button Start a trial with Shopify Basic Plan $9.99/month; Free includes a store locator with up to 2 locations, search, directions, e-mail and business hours, and the standard design. Only Basic could be chosen in the app; a Plus Plan at $29.99 was not offered in the app. The App Store listing of 17 November says Free plan available and Free trial available, with a rating of 4.8 (80). Checkout: Start a trial opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: Base Plan, $9,99 USD every 30 days, a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec, Subtotal $9,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $9,99 due 1 Dec, and Add payment method, with Approve greyed out. The sentence that you will not be billed for this test charge was not there and a payment method was asked, so nothing was approved; Cancel was clicked, no card was entered and nothing was paid. Difference with the dossier: the dossier says there is no free plan, but the app and the listing have a Free plan with a store locator for up to 2 locations; the rating on the listing is 4.8 from 80 reviews while the dossier says 4.9 from 99. The price fields are not changed here; this is for the price bundle. Cancelling: no subscription was started; the uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, GeoStock, Uninstall) says that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and requires a reason (Testing multiple apps was chosen). Not tested: the Plus Plan (not offered in the app), a custom theme integration, batch loading with many locations, back-in-stock alerts (Notify me), the store locator map, detecting the nearest store from the visitor's location, and the paid Basic features. Clean up: in the theme the block Product inventory was removed and the app embed was switched off and saved, so the theme is as before the test; GeoStock was uninstalled with the reason Testing multiple apps and no longer appeared in the list of installed apps; our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: About 30 steps and about 5 minutes were needed to see the first result, mostly in the theme editor; one of the two chosen locations was not published and the warning stayed after Locations saved; a product stocked only at that location showed Not Available; the Plus plan was not offered in the app; the approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence.
